name: Head Coverings
overview: Scripture addresses head coverings in the context of holiness, gender distinctions, and ritual purity. Leviticus 16:4 describes the high priest wearing a linen mitre as part of his holy garments, signifying consecration before God, while Numbers 5:18 shows the uncovering of a woman's head in a solemn priestly ritual. Deuteronomy 22:5 emphasizes the importance of maintaining clear distinctions between male and female attire, condemning the mixing of garments as an abomination to the LORD. Titus 2:3 calls for aged women to live in holiness and teach good things, underscoring the broader biblical theme of godly conduct connected to outward expressions of reverence.
